_comment_purpose: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 config for Phase 3 FFT/CPT of Llama-3.1-8B on 8xA100 80GB
_comment_memory: 8B params in bf16 = 16GB weights, sharded across 8 GPUs = 2GB weights/GPU. Optimizer states (AdamW: 8 bytes/param * 8B = 64GB) sharded = 8GB/GPU. Gradients sharded = 2GB/GPU. Plus activations ~30GB/GPU with grad checkpointing. Total: ~42GB/GPU peak, fits in 80GB.
